title: A Sum Hiding a Product Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Play two notes that are almost the same, together, and the sound swells and fades: loud, soft, loud, soft. Add two steady waves and a slow wobble appears. Where does it come from? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 3, Trigonometric Functions) we learn to turn a sum of sines or cosines into a product, and a product back into a sum.

You will see the whole idea in one picture: add two points on the unit circle and the result points along the half sum angle, at a distance of two cos of the half difference. We slide one angle live and watch both sides stay equal, prove cos x + cos y = 2 cos((x+y)/2) cos((x-y)/2) from the compound angle formulas in small steps, meet all four sum to product formulas and the product to sum formulas, then watch the beat appear on a live graph as two tones move apart. A pause-and-think question, a worked example (sin 75° + sin 15°), the exam trap with the minus sign in cos x - cos y, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.
